what_it_does: Infosys is a leading provider of AI-first business consulting and technology services. It enables global enterprises to accelerate business transformation, manage systems, and unlock AI value at scale, generating revenue through IT services, platforms, and software solutions.
other_facts: Total number of employees stands at 3,28,594.
Export revenues constitute approximately 97.1% of consolidated revenues in fiscal 2026.
Consolidated cash and investments total ₹43,075 crore.
